movie.title: Fight Club
movie.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.

facts: Did you know Brad Pitt's iconic character, Tyler Durden, is initially introduced as a slippery soap salesman? It's a key detail that's sometimes overshadowed by his other ventures!
Edward Norton's unnamed narrator isn't just discontent; he's specifically described as a 'ticking-time-bomb insomniac.' What a vivid way to describe his pre-club state!
The text reveals that the initial purpose of the fight clubs was to 'channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy.' Talk about an unconventional approach to self-improvement!
